infoCards.bodyText: An initiative by StimuliiQ for meritorious and financially constrained students building careers in software, data, cloud and design.

Do not let financial setbacks hold you back from a successful tech career. The StimuliiQ Scholarship grants merit-and-need-based fee waivers of up to 50% on internship-training programs — with extended mentor access and job assistance included.

heading.title: Built for every tech career aspirant
heading.subtitle: One scholarship, every program — here is what it gives you.

items.title: Completely merit and need based
items.description: Awards are decided on academic merit and financial need — nothing else.

items.title: Up to 50% fee waiver
items.description: No repayment, no service obligation. The waiver applies directly to your program fee.

items.title: Covers every StimuliiQ program
items.description: Full Stack, Data Science & AI, Cloud & DevOps, Cybersecurity, UI/UX and Digital Marketing tracks are all eligible.

items.title: Open to students across India
items.description: B.Tech, Degree, Diploma, MCA, MBA and Engineering students from any college or university can apply.

items.title: Extended mentor access
items.description: Scholars get additional 1:1 mentor sessions and personalised career guidance throughout the program.

items.title: Placement assistance included
items.description: Resume reviews, mock interviews and referrals to our hiring partners continue until you are placed.

data.heading: Application form
data.subheading: Leave your details and our scholarship team will call you within 24 hours to check your eligibility.

leadForm.heading: Apply for the scholarship
leadForm.subheading: Takes less than two minutes — no documents needed to start.

heading.title: The ₹1 Crore impact
heading.subtitle: Financial constraints should never stop a capable student from building a global tech career.

heading.title: Scholarship application process
heading.subtitle: Five steps from application to placed professional.

items.title: Check your eligibility
items.description: Fill the short application form below — it takes less than two minutes.

items.title: Submit your details
items.description: Tell us your qualification, the program you want to join and your financial background.

items.title: Receive your scholarship award
items.description: Applications are reviewed competitively and successful applicants are notified within days.

items.title: Enrol and prepare
items.description: Join your program with the fee waiver applied, plus extended mentor sessions.

items.title: Complete your internship and get placed
items.description: Finish the program, earn your certificate and access placement assistance.
